name: Kimpton Kitalay Samui
insider_take: Kimpton Kitalay Samui brings Brooklyn-meets-Bangkok vibes to Thailand's coconut coast, where industrial chic design meets tropical luxury on one of Asia's most beloved island escapes.
whats_special: This is Kimpton's first Southeast Asian property, featuring their signature quirky design aesthetic with Thai cultural touches. The hotel sits on Koh Samui's pristine Lamai Beach, where you can witness the famous Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks (Hin Ta and Hin Yai) - naturally formed rock formations that have become the island's most photographed landmarks. The property offers complimentary bike rentals to explore the island's hidden temples and local fishing villages.
pro_tip: Visit during the dry season (December-April) for perfect beach weather, and don't miss the complimentary evening wine hour - a beloved Kimpton tradition that's perfect for meeting fellow travelers while watching Koh Samui's spectacular sunsets.
dont_miss: Take a short trip to the nearby Big Buddha Temple (Wat Phra Yai), a 12-meter golden statue visible from several kilometers away. For adventure seekers, the famous Namuang Waterfalls are just a 15-minute drive inland, offering natural swimming pools surrounded by lush jungle. The hotel's rooftop bar provides stunning 360-degree views of the Gulf of Thailand and neighboring islands.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Koh Samui coastline
Distinctive Kimpton boutique hospitality and personalized service
Contemporary Thai-inspired design and luxurious amenities
World-class spa and wellness facilities with tropical treatments
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
